name: Hellkite Hatchling — "has flying and trample if it devoured a creature": Yes gives both keywords
notes: Partial sweep (single cards, 2026-10-12). Trample was dropped (the trailing "if" ended the keyword list after one keyword) and flying was unconditional. A trailing condition of a permanent's static ability that the board cannot show is now a toggle on the permanent, labelled with the condition ("It devoured a creature").
